title: Decision: COPY handler returns WC_HW_E when devCtx \!= NULL, CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE when NULL
description: wc_crypto2dev_cb():L1584-1623. When a hash object has active hardware state (devCtx \!= NULL, op_fd open), returning WC_HW_E prevents wolfSSL from doing a struct memcpy that would alias the devCtx pointer in both copies — leading to double-close of the fd and use-after-free of the heap ctx. When devCtx == NULL, CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE allows the safe memcpy. The split is exactly right. A future contributor who wants to 'simplify' by always returning CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE will introduce a dangling-pointer bug on wc_Sha256Copy while hardware hash is active.
